name: pintstackwrap
qualification: Directed same-privilege INT3 gate-width/stack-address-size witness; not standard-suite acceptance.
coverage_limits: No paging, cross-privilege entry, error-code frames, hardware IRQ, task gate, or in-slot misalignment. INT3 gate size and SS.B are independent; B=1 high-placement controls start at10000 rather than wrapping.
